News global nation business lifestyle entertainment technology sports opinion LATEST NEWS STORIES HEADLINES METRO REGIONS NATION WORLD CDN NEWSLETTER Key Moments Related Stories Key moments Related stories Special Coverage LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Nov. 11, 2026 10:41 AM November 11, 2026"> INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 10:41 AM November 11, 2026 Latest updates Latest Oldest MANILA, Philippines — The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte is set to present its third witness on Wednesday, corporate lawyer Suzette Balucanag-Punay, as the impeachment trial enters its 42nd day.
READ: Highlights: Day 41 of Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Nov. 10, 2026
Prosecution counsel Lorna Kapunan questions whether Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay has board authorization from GenCorp Industries, Inc. and Metro City Chow Foods Corp. to testify and identify company documents before the impeachment court. "The board resolution is important because we do not want, this is not to preempt the testimony of the witness, but we do not want at some point in time that she will call the attention of the honorable Presiding Officer, and hide behind the lawyer-client privilege, Your Honor." Defense counsel Justin Nichol Gular argues that the witness is appearing in compliance with a court-issued subpoena and says questioning her authority is premature. He also maintains that only the corporate clients can invoke lawyer-client privilege. #VPonTrial | @AprBenjaminINQ Follow our live updates here: https://t.co/JjibyZkNdW Watch our livestream here: https://t.co/1sMGRujiCR
Atty. Suzette Balucanag-Punay takes the witness stand on Wednesday, Nov. 11, to testify that Vice President Sara Duterte is not a stockholder, officer, or director of GenCorp Industries, Inc. #VPonTrial Follow our live updates here: https://t.co/JjibyZkNdW Watch our livestream here: https://t.co/1sMGRujiCR
The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte resumes on Wednesday, November 11. A quorum has been declared, with 13 senator-judges present. #VPonTrial | @AprBenjaminINQ Follow our live updates here: https://t.co/JjibyZkNdW Watch our livestream here: https://t.co/1sMGRujiCR
‘DIVERSIONARY TACTIC’ WATCH: House lead prosecutor Cong. Gerville Luistro says they were surprised by the defense’s sudden raising of the possible sub judice violation of prosecution counsel Jay Tolosa before the impeachment court. Luistro alleges that it was a diversionary tactic on the part of the defense. In turn, the prosecution is also considering raising before the court Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged sub judice violation, she said. #VPonTrial | @bellepechayINQ Follow our live updates here: https://t.co/JjibyZkNdW Watch our livestream here: https://t.co/1sMGRujiCR
